profile: Iovance Biotherapeutics develops and commercializes tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte cell therapies for patients with solid tumor cancers. Its commercial products include Amtagvi, an individualized T-cell therapy for previously treated advanced melanoma, and Proleukin, an interleukin-2 product used in the Amtagvi treatment regimen and other applications. The company also develops TIL therapies and related approaches for additional solid tumor cancers, including lung cancer and sarcomas.
